scheme_name: Community Canning & Training On Fruit Preservation
other_conditions: Training is targeted at ladies, housewives, college girls, and members of Mahila samity or SHG groups.
Training is conducted primarily in rural areas.
Training durations offered: 1, 3, 6 days for home‑scale preservation; 7 to 15 days for small‑scale cottage industry training.
benefits_summary: Provides training and facilities for women to preserve fruits and vegetables at home and to start small‑scale cottage enterprises.
